title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence.


From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.

  • Possibilidade de ampliação do escopo para um projeto de automatização do processo de acompanhamento existente.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida na gestão de projetos complexos e multifuncionais, conduzindo iniciativas do planejamento à entrega, com foco em previsibilidade, eficiência e valor para o negócio;
  • Vivência consistente na gestão de métricas estratégicas e operacionais de projetos, com foco em performance, previsibilidade e geração de valor;
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos preditivas e ágeis, com capacidade de adaptação conforme o contexto e a maturidade do time;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para definição, acompanhamento e interpretação de métricas e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Conhecimento em processos de alocação, planejamento e monitoramento de capacidade, garantindo equilíbrio entre demanda, esforço e entrega;
  • Habilidade para estruturar, analisar e comunicar relatórios financeiros e operacionais de forma clara e orientada à tomada de decisão;
  • Capacidade analítica apurada para suportar decisões rápidas, assertivas e baseadas em dados;
  • Excelente organização e planejamento, assegurando eficiência operacional e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Habilidade para mediação de conflitos, negociação e gestão de expectativas em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e forte orientação à entrega contínua de valor para o negócio.

title: Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain to lead and deliver SAP Supply Chain programs and projects in complex, global environments.

This role requires strong experience managing SAP initiatives (ECC and S/4HANA) , coordinating cross‑functional and multicultural teams, and driving end‑to‑end delivery across Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, and ERP landscapes .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP Supply Chain projects and programs (ECC and S/4HANA) from initiation to closure.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, and quality across multiple workstreams.
  • Coordinate global, cross‑functional teams (IT, business, vendors, and integrators).
  • Drive delivery of SAP initiatives across Supply Chain domains (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Warehousing).
  • Act as main interface between business stakeholders and IT teams .
  • Apply project governance, PMO standards, and delivery methodologies .
  • Support SAP S/4HANA assessments, upgrades, rollouts, and transformations .
  • Manage dependencies across SAP and non‑SAP systems (Oracle, legacy platforms, integrations).
  • Oversee testing phases (SIT, UAT), cutover, go‑live, and hypercare.
  • Ensure executive‑level communication, reporting, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Contribute to portfolio management , roadmap definition, and prioritization.
  • Identify risks, resolve conflicts, and ensure successful outcomes.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Solid experience in IT Project Management , with strong focus on SAP .
  • Proven experience managing SAP Supply Chain projects/programs .
  • Solid understanding of SAP ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.
  • Experience working with global / multi‑country teams .
  • Strong knowledge of project management best practices (waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Experience coordinating vendors, system integrators, and offshore teams .
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.


Certifications (Required or Preferred)

  • PMP® (mandatory or strong plus)
  • PMI‑ACP®, CSM®, ITIL® (nice to have)
  • SAP project or program management experience highly valued


Nice to Have

  • Experience as SAP Program Manager or Portfolio Lead .
  • Exposure to Supply Chain processes (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning).
  • Experience with S/4HANA transformation programs .
  • Background in consumer goods, manufacturing, agribusiness, or industrial sectors .
  • PMO setup or governance model implementation experience.


Keywords for ATS

Project Manager, SAP Project Manager, SAP Program Manager, SAP Supply Chain, S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Logistics, SAP Manufacturing, SAP SCM, Portfolio Management, PMO, PMP, Agile, Global Projects, ERP Transformation

title: Operador Técnico
description:

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Position: Procurement Associate

Location: Remote

Contract Position


We are seeking a Tactical Buyer / Procurement Specialist with hands-on experience in direct materials or purchased finished goods, ideally within nonwovens, personal care products, or tissue products.

Summary

In this role, you will support procurement operations with a strong focus on supply continuity, order processing, and project execution.   • Background in Procurement supporting direct materials or purchased finished goods (nonwoven, personal care, or tissue products a plus).
  • Experience working with suppliers/vendors and handling supplier communications.
  • Experience with ERP systems required; SAP or Coupa experience strongly preferred (Coupa highly valued).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word).
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Project Manager (Remote – Brazil)

This role combines project management, client engagement, and product strategy in a fast-moving fintech environment.

  • Translate client requirements into clear product and engineering deliverables

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, product, and QA

Product Strategy & Optimization
  • Help clients improve loan conversion and underwriting outcomes
  • Recommend workflow improvements and product enhancements
  • Analyze feedback, usage patterns, and performance metrics
  • Collaborate with Hitch product leadership on roadmap decisions
  • Identify opportunities to automate processes and improve borrower experience


Requirements & Execution
  • Gather and document detailed functional and technical requirements

What We’re Looking For
Required Experience

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience managing complex software delivery projects
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements

  • Experience with underwriting or financial workflow optimization

Success in This Role

You will succeed if you:

  • Deliver projects on time with strong client satisfaction
  • Help improve client conversion and underwriting outcomes
  • Provide clear structure and direction to engineering teams
  • Identify product improvements that create measurable business impact
  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders


Why Join Hitch
  • Work directly with major mortgage lenders shaping next-generation lending technology
  • High ownership and direct impact on product and client success
  • Fast-moving startup environment with strong growth opportunity
  • Collaborative, technical, and product-driven culture

title: \"Analista de suporte Ecommerce Pleno #993094\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.

  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.

title: Analista de Growth & Product (Pleno/Sênior)
description:

Posição Pleno/Sênior, para quem já atuou diretamente com métricas de growth e evolução de produto/jornada.

Não é uma vaga júnior nem de suporte operacional ou marketing.


Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Growth & Product (Pleno/Sênior) para ser dono(a) da evolução, conversão e escala do nosso principal produto de aquisição e receita: WhatsApp + Chatbot .


Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar dados, fricções reais da operação e feedbacks dos executivos em experimentos, melhorias de produto e impacto direto nos resultados do negócio , atuando com forte ownership sobre a jornada, métricas e backlog . Terá responsabilidade direta sobre KPIs de ativação, conversão, abandono, retenção e retorno , trabalhando de forma data-driven , com experimentação contínua e integração com marketing, vendas, tecnologia e dados .


Responsabilidades principais (Growth & Conversão)


Analisar, otimizar e evoluir continuamente a jornada de conversão no chatbot e WhatsApp.

Mapear e acompanhar dados de:

  • Ativação
  • Engajamento
  • Retenção
  • Retorno
  • Receita

Identificar gargalos de abandono ao longo do funil conversacional e propor melhorias contínuas.

Mapear e otimizar micro e macro conversões ao longo da jornada do cliente.

Planejar, executar e analisar experimentos de growth (testes A/B) envolvendo:

  • Mensagens
  • Ofertas
  • Timing de follow-ups
  • Fluxos conversacionais

Criar e testar estratégias de:

  • Ativação
  • Reengajamento
  • Repescagem via WhatsApp

Estruturar e evoluir segmentações de base , como:

  • Leads não ativados
  • Clientes inativos
  • Clientes recorrentes
  • Novos clientes

Acompanhar, analisar e reportar KPIs do canal conversacional , propondo planos de ação contínuos.

Desenvolver análises de jornada e dashboards em parceria com o time de dados.

  • Maximizar o uso da ColmeIA para automação, personalização e escala.


Atuar como responsável pela visão e evolução do produto chatbot e jornada conversacional.

Mapear a jornada ponta a ponta (lead → ativação → venda → pós-venda → retorno).

Traduzir dados, métricas e feedbacks reais em:

  • Melhorias de fluxo
  • Requisitos de produto
  • Novas funcionalidades

Criar, priorizar e manter o backlog do produto , equilibrando impacto, esforço e urgência.

Trabalhar junto ao time de tecnologia na especificação, validação e entrega das melhorias.

Atuar pontualmente no atendimento a executivos via WhatsApp/DM para entender dúvidas reais e fricções da jornada.

Identificar dúvidas operacionais recorrentes (consulta, venda, cadastro, app, comissão) e transformá-las em insumos para automação e melhoria de produto .

Organizar e manter atualizada a documentação oficial da jornada e fluxos , garantindo clareza, padronização e escalabilidade.

Categorizar interações por temas (consulta, venda, app, comissão, indicação) para apoiar análises e decisões.

Garantir feedback claro ao executivo e validação de que o processo foi concluído com sucesso.


Métricas sob responsabilidade

  • Taxa de ativação (lead → primeira ação relevante)
  • Conversão por etapa do funil do chatbot
  • Taxa de abandono por estágio
  • Tempo médio de contratação
  • Taxa de retenção e recompra
  • Conversão de campanhas e repescagens
  • ROI e eficiência dos disparos no WhatsApp


Requisitos essenciais

  • Experiência prévia atuando diretamente em Growth, Conversão ou Lifecycle , com responsabilidade sobre métricas de ativação, conversão, retenção ou receita .
  • Vivência prática na análise e otimização de funis de aquisição, ativação e retenção, com decisões tomadas a partir de dados.
  • Experiência com chatbots, automações ou canais conversacionais (WhatsApp, chat, CRM), utilizando esses canais como alavancas de conversão , e não apenas atendimento.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com histórico de tomada de decisão baseada em dados , métricas e experimentação.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em métricas de CRO, retenção, LTV e cohort , usando esses indicadores para priorização de ações.
  • Boa comunicação para trabalhar de forma integrada com times de marketing, vendas, dados e tecnologia , traduzindo análises em ações práticas.


Diferenciais (muito valorizados)

  • Experiência com a ferramenta ColmeIA (principal diferencial).
  • Experiência com WhatsApp API, automação de mensagens ou CRM conversacional.
  • Vivência em fintech, crédito, produtos financeiros ou alta escala de leads.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI, SQL ou análise de dados.
  • Experiência com testes A/B e frameworks de growth.

title: Senior TypeScript Functional Backend Engineer (Integrations) LATAM
description:
Description

We are hiring a Senior Functional Backend Engineer to help us connect to insurance portals across the U.S. to ingest, transform, and deliver structured healthcare data — including claims, EOBs, plan documents, and accumulators.

This role sits at the intersection of production reliability and system design. You’ll own integration health in production, onboard new portals, expand data coverage, and write clean, strongly typed backend code. The team values functional principles - composability, explicit error handling, type safety - and uses Effect extensively, but prior Effect experience is not required.

This is hands-on engineering in a system where correctness and clarity matter.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities

Production Triage & Reliability

  • Own first-response triage for portal integration failures
  • Debug login automation issues, crawl failures, and ingestion errors
  • Trace failures across logs, workflows, and monitoring systems
  • Implement clean, durable fixes - not just patches
  • Escalate systemic platform issues when appropriate

Portal Onboarding

  • Bring new insurance portals into production
  • Reverse-engineer APIs and browser workflows
  • Build ingestion pipelines and validate structured outputs
  • Ensure integrations remain resilient as portals evolve

Data Expansion

  • Extend existing integrations to capture new data types
  • Maintain strong typing and predictable transformations
  • Guard against schema drift and data inconsistencies

Collaboration

  • Contribute to runbooks and documentation
  • Participate in async standups and structured handoffs
  • Work closely with a platform-focused engineering team


Requirements

  • 4+ years of Strongly Typed Backend Experience
  • Deep experience in strongly typed languages (TypeScript , Scala, Kotlin, Go, etc.)
  • Careful API modeling and schema validation
  • Comfort designing systems where types act as contracts
  • Functional or Declarative Programming Experience
  • You don’t need to come from a pure Functional Programming background, but you should be comfortable with immutability, explicit handling, declarative composition, and writing predictable, testable code.
  • TypeScript (Backend)
  • Experience building backend services
  • NestJS experience preferred

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Effect (TypeScript Library)
  • If not, you should be comfortable learning it and working within a composable, typed effect system
  • Playwright or browser automation
  • API reverse-engineering via browser devtools
  • Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar)
  • Data ingestion or transformation pipelines
  • Observability tooling (Datadog or similar)
  • AWS experience

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Company: Confidential

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: Full-time/Contract

Location: Remote (Open to those in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia)


Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal


Interview Process

  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner
  • Paid project
  • Final interview with CEO/owner

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

Our current investment portfolios include:

  • Emergence Mobility Technologies (AutoTech) – Next-generation vehicle acquisition and inventory management platforms
  • Emergence Healthcare Technologies (HCIT) – High-efficiency billing optimization, patient engagement, and clinical care software
  • Emergence Container Technologies (Cloud Infrastructure) – Modern DevOps, observability, and secure cloud performance tools
  • Emergence Procurement Technologies (Supply Chain Tech) – Procurement, logistics, and manufacturing visibility systems


The Role

Strategic Finance & Investments – Analyst

  • Finance at Emergence is not “reporting after the fact.” It is how we make decisions. The bar is high because the work gets used in real rooms with real stakes.
  • This is a hybrid role that sits between investing and strategic finance. You will help build the financial engine across more than 10+ growing portfolio companies in different sectors, including Auto, Healthcare, and Infrastructure Software.
  • It is a great seat for someone early in their career who wants real reps, fast feedback, and a lot of ownership. You will learn quickly because you will have to. You will also get exposed to the CEO and CFO level across U.S. software businesses in addition to the management team at Emergence.


What You Will Spend Your Time Doing

You will do a mix of hands-on building and higher-level thinking, including:

  • Building and maintaining detailed operating models used to forecast performance and guide decisions (revenue, retention, pricing, hiring plans, cash, and scenarios)
  • Standing up “finance infrastructure” that actually works across portfolio companies, including reporting packages, KPI dashboards, budget versus actuals, and forecasting cadences
  • Supporting investor and capital raise work, including preparing materials, cleaning up data rooms, and tightening the metrics story so it holds up under scrutiny
  • Working closely with accounting leaders to improve the quality of the numbers (close hygiene, chart of accounts structure, consistency of definitions, and data integrity)
  • Contributing to new M&A theses and diligence, including market research, unit economics work, and translating messy diligence inputs into clear decision memos


What Makes Someone Successful Here

This is not a role where you can hide behind “good effort.” The models either tie out or they do not.

People who do well here tend to:

  • Take pride in accuracy and consistency, even on the unglamorous stuff
  • Catch issues early and fix them without needing a lot of airtime
  • Ask sharp questions and then go do the work to answer them
  • Communicate clearly in English, both in writing and live, because you will work with U.S.-based executives and investors
  • Stay calm when priorities shift, and still deliver something clean


Requirements

  • 1 to 7 years of IB, PE, or VC experience (or an extremely close equivalent)
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including building models from scratch and stress-testing assumptions
  • Solid accounting and finance fundamentals (you do not need to be a CPA, but you do need to know what you are looking at)
  • Ability to overlap meaningfully with U.S. working hours

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

O que esperamos de você:

title: Lead Functional Analyst / Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Product & Delivery Execution
  • Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
  • Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Experience managing multiple release timelines
  • Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
  • Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


  • Quality & Compliance Mindset
  • Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
  • Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


  • Release & Operational Skills
  • Experience coordinating software releases end to end
  • Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
  • Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


  • Tools & Ways of Working
  • Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


  • Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
  • Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.
