Mútua is seeking a hands-on, entrepreneurial and AI-native Head of Engineering to orchestrate our technical operations and co-build the company at its next stage of growth. In this role, you will be a core technical partner, building alongside the team to ensure that our technical execution reflects our mission and product vision.

As our Head of Engineering, you will combine leadership and execution. You will lead the software engineering front while deeply engaging with AI Engineering, bringing agentic solutions from prototype to scalable production.


About the Role


This is a senior leadership role with strong hands-on execution. You will own architecture, delivery, and production reliability across software, data, and AI systems.


Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Hands-on Architecture & Development: Design and build core backend, data, and AI components; review code and contribute to critical features.
  • Team Leadership: Set priorities, mentor engineers, enforce high technical standards, and ensure consistent delivery.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps Collaboration: Work closely with the CTO on cloud architecture, CI/CD, observability, security, and scalability.
  • Agentic AI Prototyping: Partner with the Senior AI Expert to prototype, test, and productionize agentic workflows.
  • AI Productionization: Define orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and reliability standards for AI systems in production.
  • Engineering Operations: Structure agile workflows, remove bottlenecks, and maintain speed with rigor.
  • Technical Governance: Establish pragmatic standards across SDLC, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Translate product and business needs into clear technical priorities.


About Mútua


Mútua is building a global intelligence infrastructure for the impact ecosystem, powered by AI and collective intelligence. Our platform helps actors navigate complex social and environmental challenges requiring coordinated action across sectors and geographies.


We enable funders, innovators, researchers, and ecosystem actors to align around shared missions, improving how capital is informed and deployed. By structuring knowledge and mapping ecosystems, Mútua supports faster, more accurate, and more transparent funding decisions across critical systems such as food, energy, education, and healthcare.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for a purpose-driven technical builder with deep execution strength across software, data, and AI:


  • Entrepreneurial Profile: Builder mindset, comfortable in early-stage ambiguity, aiming to join as a long-term partner.
  • Technical Depth: Strong track record across backend systems, data engineering, and AI/ML in production environments.
  • Agentic Systems Experience: Proven experience bringing agentic or autonomous AI systems from prototype to scalable production.
  • Infrastructure & DevOps Acumen: Solid experience with cloud, CI/CD, monitoring, reliability, and security best practices.
  • Architectural Judgment: Ability to design AI-native systems balancing speed, cost, scalability, and robustness.
  • Execution Discipline: Brings structure without slowing momentum; high ownership and delivery focus.
  • Systems Thinking: Understands how technical architecture supports systemic impact at scale.
  • Purpose-Oriented: Motivated to contribute to the societal sustainability transition aligned with Mútua’s mission.
  • Strong Communication: Clear, direct, and able to align technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Practical Details


  • Role: Head of Engineering (Full-time).
  • Location: Remote-first.
  • Work Model: Highly flexible, task-based structure with high ownership and autonomy.
  • Performance & Growth: Transparent 360° feedback culture and clear career progression path.
  • 1-3% in Stock Options and compensation aligned with market benchmarks for early-stage startups in your geography

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados (DS4) para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).
  • Garantir clareza de premissas e limites das soluções (dados, regras e critérios), com documentação e governança para adoção e manutenção.
  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.

-Project Management

  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.

  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

Environment & Collaboration

Tools & Ways of Working

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
  • 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
  • Day off no aniversário

title: Administrador de Servidor Freelance / Administrador Web
description:
Estamos buscando um Administrador de Servidor Freelance / Administrador Web experiente e detalhista para gerenciar e manter nossos servidores de hospedagem web Linux e Windows. Essa função é crucial para garantir a confiabilidade, o desempenho e a segurança de nossos serviços de hospedagem web. O candidato ideal terá uma sólida experiência em manutenção de servidores, solução de problemas e tarefas gerais de gerenciamento de servidores, com flexibilidade para estar de plantão à noite e nos fins de semana.


*Responsabilidades:*


- Executar manutenção regular, atualizações e patches em servidores Linux e Windows.

- Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas relacionados a serviços de hospedagem web, incluindo desempenho de site, e-mail e funcionalidade de banco de dados.

- Monitorar o desempenho, o tempo de atividade e a segurança do servidor, implementando medidas preventivas para minimizar o tempo de inatividade.

- Configurar e manter ambientes de hospedagem web, incluindo cPanel, Plesk ou painéis de controle semelhantes.

- Diagnosticar e mitigar vulnerabilidades de segurança, garantindo que os servidores sigam as melhores práticas de segurança de hospedagem web.

- Gerenciar configurações de DNS e solucionar problemas relacionados a domínios.

- Colaborar com equipes internas ou clientes para atender a solicitações ou incidentes relacionados à hospedagem.

- Criar e manter documentação para configurações de servidor, processos e procedimentos de solução de problemas.

- Estar disponível para plantões noturnos e de fim de semana para responder prontamente a problemas críticos de servidor ou hospedagem.

- Possibilidade de conversar com o cliente diretamente


*Requisitos:*


  • Experiência comprovada em administração de servidores e gerenciamento de hospedagem na web (ambientes Linux e Windows).
  • Sólido conhecimento de tecnologias de hospedagem na web, incluindo Apache, Nginx, IIS, MySQL/MariaDB e PHP.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de painel de controle, como cPanel, Plesk ou DirectAdmin.
  • Compreensão de DNS, certificados SSL e configurações de servidor de e-mail (por exemplo, SMTP, IMAP, POP3).
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança, incluindo firewalls, detecção de malware e prevenção de intrusão.
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas e resolver problemas de hospedagem rapidamente sob pressão.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa, conforme necessário.
  • Disponibilidade para suporte de plantão durante a noite e fins de semana.


*Qualificações preferenciais:*


  • Certificações como RHCE, MCSE ou equivalente são um plus.
  • Experiência com plataformas de hospedagem em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud) é vantajosa.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de script como Bash, Python ou PowerShell para automação.

title: Senior Data Visualization Engineer
description:
Senior Data Visualization Engineer (Tableau & Databricks Specialist)



Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Data Visualization Engineer.



Role Overview


We are seeking a highly autonomous Senior Data Visualization Engineer to lead our business intelligence efforts. As the sole subject matter expert in this space, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of high-impact dashboards—from architectural design in Databricks to final visualization in Tableau .

This is a “team of one” role. You will be the primary consultant to our leadership team, translating complex data into actionable insights without the need for day-to-day technical oversight.



Key Responsibilities


  • End-to-End Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain automated, scalable dashboards and reports.
  • Data Engineering: Write and optimize complex SQL queries within Databricks to transform raw data into performant gold-layer tables.
  • Architecture: Establish best practices for data modeling and dashboard performance tuning to ensure fast load times for large datasets.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate directly with stakeholders to define KPIs and requirements, acting as both the strategist and the executor.
  • Self-Management: Manage the full project lifecycle, including documentation, testing, and deployment, with complete independence.



Required Qualifications


  • Expert Tableau Skills: 5+ years of experience building advanced visualizations (LOD expressions, complex parameters, and API integrations).
  • Databricks Mastery: Proficiency in using Databricks for data processing, including strong SQL skills and familiarity with Delta Lake architecture.
  • Data Modeling: Proven ability to build “analysis-ready” data structures—you know how to join and aggregate data for maximum dashboard efficiency.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A track record of standing up BI functions or working as a solo contributor in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: The ability to explain technical data concepts to non-technical executives clearly and concisely.



Preferred Skills


  • Experience with Tableau Server/Online administration.
  • Knowledge of Python or PySpark for advanced data manipulation.
  • Certifications in Tableau Desktop or Databricks Data Engineering.



Why this role is different

Because you will be our only Tableau expert, you won’t be bogged down by “design by committee.” You will have total creative and technical ownership over our BI roadmap and the opportunity to define how this company sees its data.



Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.


Kindly note that CVs must be submitted in English.

Enterprise Architecture & Data Platform Leadership

Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development

  • Develop and maintain subject area models, business data models, and dimensional models (fact and dimension tables) and Semantic layer design for BI and AI solutions.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, and business definitions; resolve conflicts in terminology and meaning.
  • Build and maintain enterprise semantic layers to support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
  • Support standardization of facts, dimensions, and shared business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, cost‑optimized, and reliable data architectures in cloud environments.


Data Governance, Quality & Metadata

  • Ensure strong data governance, security, lineage, and compliance across platforms.
  • Perform data quality assessments and identify appropriate data sources in partnership with Business/Data Analysts.
  • Maintain metadata in the enterprise repository and ensure alignment with governance standards.
  • Assist in developing source‑to‑target mappings and validating data transformations.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct user interviews, requirements sessions, and data analysis reviews.
  • Provide architectural oversight and review solution designs across engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts to ensure consistent adoption of architectural standards.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to align data solutions with business needs.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Hands‑on expertise with Databricks; building and maintaining medallion architecture.
  • Strong background in data modeling: dimensional, 3NF, and data vault.
  • Proficiency with Spark, SQL, Python, Kafka, Five Tran, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks.Knowledge of BI/Analytics/AI tools i.e., Power BI, ML Flow, Sage maker, Etc.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.Ability to influence technical, business, and executive audiences.

title: UX Research Analyst
description:
This role is 100% remote. Candidates must be able to work cross-over hours with the US. Candidates MUST also be fluent in English.


Pulse Labs is empowering insights and elevating experiences for the world's top technology companies. Backed by investors including Google and Amazon, we're revolutionizing product development delivering human-centered, actionable insights at every stage of the product lifecycle from inception to market release and beyond. We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.


If you thrive in a fast-paced multi-project environment and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute qualitative research projects such as diary studies, focus groups, IDIs, longitudinal panel studies, etc.


You will be a team-player who is an integral member of a talented and dedicated group of researchers working in a fast-paced, rapid-response environment where rigor and quality are paramount. Using Pulse Labs' proprietary tools and platforms, you’ll dive deep into rich video and survey data to analyze and interpret users’ interactions with and perceptions about next-gen products.


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers to understand research projects, including customer requirements, timelines, analysis plan, and business goals.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining research timelines, project schedules, question banks, data repositories, and other research-related artifacts.
  • Work closely with the operations team to make sure collected data matches the study requirements.
  • Ensure sound research methods while assisting with initial project plans, analyses, and creating final reports for clients.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for clients.
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, create deliverables for clients including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.
  • Develop high quality data visualizations, communicating data and findings cleanly, effectively, and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the team and across the company to improve our internal processes.
  • Provide feedback to the Design and Engineering teams about how to improve our proprietary platform.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, research methods, survey methodology, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working as an analyst in a research setting or in a detail-oriented operations environment.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end research lifecycle, including research methods/approaches and common analyses, specifically those related to UX.
  • Expertise with data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Experience working on a team of researchers as well as alongside operations personnel in a rapid-response, often ambiguous environment.
  • Ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in qualitative and/or quantitative data.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

**Fully Remote 6-month contract**


Qualifications

Is not expected to be an authority but can demonstrate good industry and technology awareness. Proactively contributing to ongoing improvement in the company’s security posture.

title: Crypto Client & Operations Specialist (Private Segment)

title: React Native Developer | Mid
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma empresa global que integra o grupo AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Construir componentes de interface seguindo o Design System, incluindo temas, variações e estilos específicos para diferentes brands;
  • Desenvolver telas e lógicas essenciais, integrando com BFFs existentes e garantindo padronização e boas práticas;
  • Consumir serviços REST/GraphQL, aplicar interceptors, lidar com autenticação, tratamento de erros e estados de carregamento;
  • Implementar chamadas de rede dentro do módulo centralizado, seguindo padrões de segurança e resiliência definidos;
  • Aplicar o wrapper criado para rastreamento analítico, garantindo uso correto dos eventos e consistência no envio de dados;
  • Aplicar internacionalização (i18n) e formatação regionalizada (moeda, datas, pluralização), suportando PT-BR, EN e ES;
  • Implementar componentes, fluxos e módulos fundamentais do projeto, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência à arquitetura definida pelo Tech Lead;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento da base white label do novo aplicativo, garantindo que a solução esteja preparada para múltiplas marcas;
  • Aplicar testes unitários, criar hooks personalizados, revisar código e contribuir para manter a base enxuta e escalável;
  • Trabalhar em times ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), colaborando com o time técnico e demais áreas do produto.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência sólida com React Native em projetos de médio e grande porte;
  • Forte domínio de TypeScript e boas práticas de tipagem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado utilizando Context API, Redux ou Zustand;
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs REST e/ou GraphQL, autenticadas e tipadas;
  • Implementação de componentes reutilizáveis, estilização avançada e integração com Design System;
  • Conhecimento em temas, branding dinâmico e customização white label;
  • Entendimento de navegação complexa com React Navigation (deep links, params tipados, nested navigation);
  • Experiência com Push Notifications, links dinâmicos e permissões de plataforma;
  • Utilização de ferramentas de analytics (Firebase, GA4, etc.) através de wrappers internos;
  • Familiaridade com Git, PRs, code review e padrões de branch;
  • Experiência prévia com arquiteturas modulares e multi-brand (desejável);
  • Experiência com configuração de pipelines CI/CD para mobile (desejável);
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox) (desejável);
  • Noções de desenvolvimento nativo (Swift/Kotlin) para integração de módulos (desejável);
  • Experiência com publicação, assinatura e gerenciamento na App Store e Google Play (desejável);
  • Vivência com uso de feature flags, remote config e parametrização dinâmica (desejável).
